name: Keeper Morwen

intro.text: Up the Tor in the dark, were you? Brave. Or lost. The two look the same from here.
Fae creatures don't fight fair, love. They fight interesting. Let's see if you can keep up.

win: Well. The lanterns have stopped laughing at you. That's how I know you've won.
after: Mind the orchard on your way down. It's been listening.
